 Transportation Singapore Airlines takes 44% profit hit in 1st half on soaring fuel costs
 Fuel expenses rise 90%, outweighing strong passenger and cargo demand
 Singapore Airlines planes at its Changi Airport hub. © Reuters
 KENTARO TAKEDA November 11, 2026 21:57 JST SINGAPORE -- Singapore Airlines said on Wednesday that its net profit for the April-September period dropped 43.9% from a year earlier to 134 million Singapore dollars ($104 million), as soaring jet fuel prices outweighed robust growth in passenger traffic and revenue.
